title: Programming recall
introduction: Recover state tracing, decisions, loops, indexed lists, functions, and evidence-based debugging through a clearly stated Python 3 subset. This optional refresher awards no university credit and establishes no enrollment eligibility. Familiarity and assisted work are separate from independent evidence. Independent human review is pending.

modules.title: From program state to tested behavior

lessons.title: Values, assignment, and decisions
lessons.objective: Trace typed values and sequential assignments, evaluate arithmetic and Boolean conditions, and select the correct branch including equality boundaries.

lessons.title: Loops and indexed collections
lessons.objective: Trace counted and condition-controlled loops, use valid zero-based list indices, and accumulate or filter values while accounting for empty inputs and termination.

lessons.title: Functions, contracts, and shared data
lessons.objective: Trace parameters, local variables and return values, distinguish printing from returning, and predict list aliasing versus a shallow copy under an explicit function contract.

lessons.title: Debugging with evidence and boundary tests
lessons.objective: Classify syntax, runtime and logic failures, trace the first divergent state, choose a justified repair, and design tests for normal, boundary and invalid cases without claiming that passing examples prove general correctness.
